fields.label: Country
fields.note: PCSX drops filter_country for this tenant (not echoed in appliedFilters), so country is derived from the location labels and filtered locally.

notes: jobs.autodesk.com is Autodesk's own Eightfold PCSX careers site. GET /api/pcsx/search takes domain=autodesk.com, query, location, start and sort_by; verified live that query=engineer returns count 141, sort_by=timestamp and sort_by=relevance are echoed in data.sortBy, filter_department is echoed in data.appliedFilters, and filter_work_location_option is echoed as appliedFilters.workLocationOption. This tenant's filterDef only advertises hiring_title, skills and latlong facets, and filter_country/filter_employee_type are silently dropped, so those facets are filtered locally. Details come from /api/pcsx/position_details?position_id=...&domain=autodesk.com.
